results.baseline: Ctrl+Z did not restore GtkEntry text

changes: Bounded per-control history, UTF8 text/cursor/selection and numeric spin value.
CtrlZ/CtrlY/CtrlShiftZ, native Cut/Copy/Paste/SelectAll and Undo/Redo menu.
GTK3 Entry/TextView/SpinButton use the adapter; history survives NativeScene.build destruction/recreation.
Spin restoration updates numeric value from restored valid text, retaining partial input.

tests.native_keyboard: real X keyboard, native clipboard, three controls in each runtime; GTK3 rebuilt actual scene
tests.gtk2_clipboard_fixture: Gdk2 typelib lacks atom_intern; installed public GTK2 C clipboard API used only by fixture

post_native_nonfunctional_changes: Module docstring clarifies process lifetime. Undo/Redo menu tooltip texts added after native interaction proofs; hover display not tested.
limits: History is in memory of one preview process; no native-field journal across process exit, controller child replacement or new instance. Motif editor journal remains independent.
GTK2 field adapter foundation proved; GtkEntry theme generation/scene/controller integration still pending.
GTK3 editing tested in NativeScene separate window, not a new Motif-hosted keyboard matrix.
Not a historical/palette fidelity test or user acceptance.
Delivery pending exact theme coordination; user window stays open.
failed_logs: baseline.err: original fixture lacked native focus/XDG isolation
baseline-fixed.err: X display unavailable in reused test directory
gtk3-isolated.err: insert-text typelib marshalling warnings, handler removed
scene-native.err and scene-diagnosed.err: SpinButton reconstruction failed before numeric/text synchronization

coverage.basis: catalog count, not total goal or fidelity
